meta.title: Nexera for DSH
meta.description: Nexera is a growing DeepSeek Harness workspace plugin; version 1.1.0-beta ships shared sticky notes with agent memory. The sidebar gains a Sticky notes panel beside Plugins and Automation tasks: a wall of taped-up note cards, a full-page editor behind New note, and automatic saving to the Host. Every note carries an AI scope — private, all chats, or one workspace — and a note marked as memory becomes a permanent fact about you (personality, what you love doing) that the assistant reads in every conversation. The assistant can also create, read and update notes itself through the sticky_notes tool, so telling it to remember something is enough. Every browser page this DSH instance serves, including phone pages reached through the DSH mobile plugin, reads the same wall, so a second person who opens the page edits the very same notes; the Invite button in the panel header copies the link to send them. Notes live in $DSH_HOME/sticky-notes/notes.json on this machine and are never sent anywhere else. Turning the plugin off removes the sidebar row and the wall; the notes file stays until you delete it.
